name: Bregon

attributes.attribute: named in the Book of Invasions

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bregon is an Irish hero. The Book of Invasions names him. That text tells Irish mythological history. He was an ancestor of the Milesians. The Milesians were the final conquerors of the island.

okr.objective: Describe Bregon, the Irish hero and ancestor of the Milesians.
key_results: The Book of Invasions names him.
He was an ancestor of the Milesians.
The Milesians were the final conquerors of the island.
